title: Award-Winning Private Cottage
description:
Awarded with the Architectural Historic Preservation award in Nashville, this eclectic and cozy, private cottage is ready for your arrival! Enjoy staying just a short walk away from some of Nashville's best coffee shops and restaurants.  This location is minutes from downtown, yet quiet and accessible to everything!  Easy, off-street parking. Pets by pre-approval. Pet fee is $125 per pet. ***please note that this property no longer offers a pool or hot tub***

The space
This is a PRIVATE open concept living space with a cathedral ceiling, luxury bath and kitchenette. The cottage is beautifully decorated with a sense of warmth and coziness that will make you want to stay a while! The loft has a set of twin beds that is accessed by a rolling ladder.  This ladder is not a toy and is only to be used to access sleeping. This notification serves as a hold harmless waiver for use of the ladder to access the loft. The loft sleeping area is accessed by the  ladder and open to the living space below. ***This property no longer offers a pool or hot tub***

Guest access
Our location is less than two miles from downtown. Our neighborhood is walkable to coffee shops and restaurants. Uber and Lyft are great options for a quick ride downtown. We have off-street parking for one vehicle and street parking an additonal vehicle.

Other things to note
There is an outdoor patio with a table and chairs. 
Easy, free parking available. ***This property no longer offers a pool or hot tub***
